### Enforcement hook contracts
from: [[decision:spec-provenance-html-comment]] + [[decision:global-hooks-project-opt-in]]
retrieved: 2026-05-23

- enforce-spec.sh must use OR logic: `grep -q 'nana:approved'` OR existing exit-criteria check for backward compat with ~20 marker-less specs
- Hook exit codes: 0=allow (tool use proceeds), 2=block (stderr shown to Claude)
- Enforcement hooks are global (~/.claude/hooks/) with project opt-in via .claude/enforce marker

### MANIFEST format
from: [[decision:hook-prefix-nana-namespace]] + [[journal:2026-05-23-phase-28-dx-discoverability-complete]]
retrieved: 2026-05-23

- Two sections: checksums (109 lines of md5+path) then descriptions (`# <dir>: <first sentence from SKILL.md>`)
- Descriptions are additive comment section — existing checksum lines must not change
- Kit path marker at ~/.claude/.nana-dev-kit-path stores install source path

### Event logging precedent
from: [[wiki:hook-exit-codes]] + audit-log.sh
retrieved: 2026-05-23

- audit-log.sh writes JSONL to .nana/audit.jsonl — same format for enforcement.log
- Log entries: one-line JSON with timestamp, hook name, action, result
- Truncation via `tail -n 500` to cap log size
